combat_operation.include: Reported military use of force or an ongoing combat operation.
combat_operation.exclude: Exercises, hypothetical threats and procurement without combat.

military_deployment.include: Movement, stationing or operational repositioning of military forces.
military_deployment.exclude: Platform acquisition without an evidenced force movement; civilian travel.

military_exercise.include: An organized military training exercise or operational drill.
military_exercise.exclude: Real combat; routine ceremonial gatherings without substantive training.

weapons_procurement.include: An evidenced acquisition, contract, order, transfer or delivery of military equipment.
weapons_procurement.exclude: Speculation about purchases; technical development alone.

defense_policy.include: A substantive defense policy, budget, doctrine, force-structure or military governance development.
defense_policy.exclude: Passing political rhetoric or generic military background.

military_diplomacy.include: Substantive defense diplomacy, military cooperation or security partnership developments.
military_diplomacy.exclude: Routine visits or ceremonies without substantive defense cooperation.

military_technology.include: Military technology research, development, trials or technical capability changes.
military_technology.exclude: Commercial technology without a documented military connection; acquisition alone.

military_intelligence_surveillance.include: Substantive military intelligence, reconnaissance or surveillance activity/capability.
military_intelligence_surveillance.exclude: An intelligence agency merely being quoted; unsupported assumptions about intent.

defense_other.include: Substantive armed-forces developments, including readiness, personnel or accidents, outside named categories; explain the category gap.
defense_other.exclude: A substitute for unknown facts or a named category; purely ceremonial military-themed news.

guidance: Classify the registered article representation worldwide, independently of topic relevance. Domains and defense events are multi-label. Event instances are article-local and do not establish cross-article event identity. Every asserted label/entity/date/location and non-unknown evidence status needs exact attributed source spans. Quotes establish provenance, not semantic entailment or factual truth; a human must review. Complete event coverage is an explicit reviewer claim. Do not infer rights from accessibility, personal use, publisher or approval. Independent corroboration needs a future multi-source schema.
